tasks.title: Conversation #51
tasks.transcript:
Man: I'm looking for a good restaurant to celebrate finishing my thesis. Do you have any recommendations?
Woman: How about that new French restaurant downtown? I went last week and I had a chicken dish that was delicious.
Man: That sounds perfect. My advisor loves French food. I'll check if they have any availability for Friday night.
Woman: You might want to call them soon. I think they fill up fast.

questions.stem: What is the man looking for?

options.A: A place to have a business meeting
options.B: A place to celebrate a special occasion
options.C: A new recipe to try at home

questions.analysis: 答案：B 题目问的是：男士在寻找什么？属于细节理解题。 定位原文：Man: I'm looking for a good restaurant to celebrate finishing my thesis. 选项分析： A. A place to have a business meeting 一个举行商务会议的地方。因为男士是为了庆祝完成论文，不是为了商务会议，所以 A 选项错误。 B. A place to celebrate a special occasion 一个庆祝特殊场合的地方。由于完成论文是一个重要的个人成就，男士寻找餐厅是为了庆祝这一特殊时刻，所以 B 选项正确。 C. A new recipe to try at home 一个在家尝试的新食谱。因为男士是在寻找餐厅，而不是食谱，所以 C 选项错误。 D. A gift for his advisor 给他导师的礼物。虽然提到了导师，但男士是想请导师吃饭，而不是寻找实物礼物，所以 D 选项错误。

questions.stem: What does the woman suggest the man do next?
questions.analysis: 答案：C 题目问的是：女士建议男士接下来做什么？属于预测题。 定位原文：Woman: You might want to call them soon. I think they fill up fast. 选项分析： A. Order a chicken dish 点一份鸡肉菜。因为这是在讨论预订餐厅，而不是点菜，所以 A选项错误。 B. Look for a different restaurant 寻找另一家餐厅。因为女士是在建议尽快预订这家餐厅，而不是换一家，所以 B 选项错误。 C. Make a reservation soon 尽快预订。由于女士提到餐厅订位很快，建议男士快点打电话，这暗示了要尽快预订，所以 C 选项正确。 D. Cook a meal at home 在家做饭。因为对话全程都在讨论去餐厅用餐，所以 D 选项错误。
